steps.label: 01 · Speed
steps.title: How fast it loads [on a phone.]
steps.text: We run Google's PageSpeed phone test and find what slows your pages down. Omek's main picture now loads in 2.9s, down from 19.3s.

steps.label: 02 · Phones
steps.title: How it works [on a phone.]
steps.text: We use your website the way your buyers do, on a phone. Can they read it, tap the buttons and send you a message?

steps.label: 03 · Google
steps.title: How you show up [on Google.]
steps.text: We search for what you sell, the way a buyer would, and see who comes up: you, or someone else.
